entries.title: Psalms 41:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Blessed [is] he who acts wisely toward the poor; the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 41:2
segments: The LORD will watch over him and keep him alive; [and] he shall be blessed on the earth; and You will not deliver him to the soul of his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 41:3
segments: The LORD will hold him up on the bed of sickness; You will change all his bed in his illness.

entries.title: Psalms 41:4
segments: I said, LORD, be merciful to me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against You.

entries.title: Psalms 41:5
segments: My enemies speak evil of me, [saying], When will he die, and his name perish?

entries.title: Psalms 41:6
segments: And when he comes to see [me], he speaks vanity; his heart gathers iniquity to itself; he goes out and speaks of it.

entries.title: Psalms 41:7
segments: All my haters me whisper against me; they plot evil against me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:8
segments: They say, a wicked thing is poured out on him, and he who lies down shall rise no more.

entries.title: Psalms 41:9
segments: Even a man, my friend, in whom I trusted, who ate of my bread, has lifted up [his] heel against me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:10
segments: But You, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, so that I may repay them.

entries.title: Psalms 41:11
segments: By this I know that You delight in me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:12
segments: And I, in my integrity You uphold me; and You set me before Your face forever.

entries.title: Psalms 41:13
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD God of Israel, from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen and Amen!
